column2: step 3/5/6 composite stdout can place leading file/git kvs before the checks relay line, so `digest_file` is not on the first physical line. the planned checks failure entry macro update says read `digest_file` first and keep folded-site full-output key scan, but only `redacted_log_file` is explicitly named in today's scan rule. an implementer that first-line-reads or full-scans only `redacted_log_file` will never bind `digest_file` on step 6 (and similar folded sites), fall back to the full redacted log, and defeat digest-first consumption on a high-volume path.

the digest format and test plan only require one `check=`, `failure_count=`, `first_location=`, and `first_error=` record, but scope requires a bounded structured digest per failing check. pre-commit can report multiple failed hooks in one relevant-checks run; a single-record digest would expose only one failure, so the primary artifact would not satisfy the per-failing-check contract and the repair prompt can miss another required fix.

`_finish_logged_result` has at least two failure returns that call `_redact_log` and set `redacted_log_path`: the `rc==2` no-validation-phases early return (lines 712-725) and the generic failing-check tail (lines 738-758). the plan describes digest build/write only on the later branch. implementers following the plan literally can ship digests for ordinary lint failures while leaving the no-validation-phases redacted failure path on the old full-log contract, so `digest_file_path` / `digest_file=` are missing on a real failure mode and acceptance ("digest emitted on the failure path") is only partial. adding digest logic only in one branch also duplicates redaction-adjacent logic and invites drift.

the contains-pins phase writes `defect:` lines with no `===` section header. a header-only phase tracker will attribute those failures to the previous pre-commit or direct-make section, so `check=` can name the wrong hook or target even when `first_location` and `first_error` are correct.

the plan tells implementers to extend `test_run_relevant_checks_no_validation_phases_when_precommit_unavailable`, but the repo only has `test_run_relevant_checks_deletion_only_without_agent_lint_fails_closed` for `failure_reason=no-validation-phases`. a literal search misses the target, and the mandated digest-on-rc2 path can ship without integration coverage.
